scenarios.title: Storefront and catalog discovery
scenarios.objective: Confirm that customers can understand and safely discover only purchasable products.
prerequisites: Synthetic catalog containing eligible, ineligible, and unknown-region examples
humanSteps: Open the approved staging storefront.
Search and browse the synthetic products.
Open each eligibility example and compare availability and price.
Confirm supplier identity is not unnecessarily shown.
Capture redacted page evidence and record the result.
scenarios.expectedResult: Eligible products are understandable and coherent; ineligible or uncertain products are not purchasable.
scenarios.validatedRule: Only positively established Germany-compatible offers may be published or sold.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after the storefront transport is deployed to approved staging.

scenarios.title: Registered customer purchase journey
scenarios.objective: Confirm the complete synthetic registered-customer purchase and ownership experience.
testData: Dedicated synthetic customer B for denial check
humanSteps: Sign in as customer A and select the synthetic offer.
Complete checkout with the sandbox payment method.
Open the resulting confirmation and account purchase list.
Sign in separately as customer B and attempt to locate customer A's order.
Capture redacted confirmation and account evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: The order belongs only to customer A, messaging is coherent, and ordinary confirmation contains no Product Key.
scenarios.validatedRule: Order ownership is exact and cross-customer access is denied.
scenarios.reason: Catalog, cart, checkout shell, synthetic login and account pages exist, but sandbox payment and order creation are not composed.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute with synthetic payment after staging browser integration exists.

scenarios.title: Guest purchase journey
scenarios.objective: Confirm guest checkout creates no authenticated ownership and discloses no Product Key.
humanSteps: Check out without signing in.
Use the synthetic guest email and sandbox payment.
Read the confirmation and account-requirement instructions.
Confirm the instructions require the same checkout email.
Capture redacted confirmation evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: No key is disclosed and the guest is clearly told to use a KeyRaNo account with the same checkout email.
scenarios.validatedRule: Guest orders remain unowned until a verified same-email claim succeeds.
scenarios.reason: WooCommerce renders guest checkout, but KeyCore guest orchestration and safe post-purchase messaging are not connected.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after guest checkout and safe messaging are rendered in staging.

scenarios.title: Guest purchase claim
scenarios.objective: Confirm a verified same-email customer can permanently claim one guest purchase exactly once.
prerequisites: Verified account using the immutable checkout email
One-time claim credential supplied out of evidence channels
testData: Dedicated synthetic guest order and verified customer
humanSteps: Sign in to the verified same-email account.
Open Meine Kaeufe and choose Kauf hinzufuegen or the implemented equivalent.
Enter the claim credential without recording it.
Confirm the purchase appears and remains after a new session.
Repeat the claim and capture only the safe denial result.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ownership becomes permanent, replay is denied, and an order ID alone cannot claim the purchase.
scenarios.validatedRule: Guest claim requires verified same-email identity and a one-time credential.
scenarios.reason: The Kauf hinzufuegen account page exists, but the one-time verified-same-email claim adapter remains intentionally disconnected.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after the account claim UI is connected in approved staging.

scenarios.title: Guest claim with wrong email
scenarios.objective: Confirm a verified customer with a different email cannot claim a guest order.
prerequisites: Verified account with a different email
One-time claim credential supplied out of evidence channels
humanSteps: Sign in to the mismatched verified account.
Open the purchase-claim page.
Submit the claim without recording the credential.
Confirm the safe denial reveals no ownership details.
Capture only the redacted denial page.
scenarios.expectedResult: The claim is denied, ownership is unchanged, and the response reveals no sensitive information.
scenarios.validatedRule: Immutable checkout email must match the verified account email.
scenarios.reason: No browser claim form or customer-safe rendered denial response exists.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after the claim UI exists using isolated synthetic accounts.

scenarios.title: Secure Product Key retrieval
scenarios.objective: Confirm only the authenticated owning customer can use the intended secure reveal path.
prerequisites: Synthetic fulfilled purchase owned by customer A
testData: Synthetic fulfillment record containing non-production canary material
humanSteps: Sign in as customer A and open the purchase.
Use the dedicated secure reveal action and inspect the distinction from order status.
Confirm ordinary confirmation, invoice, and support pages omit the revealed value.
Sign in separately as customer B and attempt access.
Capture only redacted state and denial evidence, never the revealed value.
scenarios.expectedResult: Only customer A can reveal through the dedicated path; customer B is denied and all other surfaces omit the value.
scenarios.validatedRule: Authorization and exact ownership are checked immediately before decryption.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute only with approved synthetic fulfillment and redacted evidence.

scenarios.title: Delayed fulfillment
scenarios.objective: Confirm a paid order remains understandable and safe while fulfillment is pending.
prerequisites: Synthetic paid order with delayed fulfillment
humanSteps: Open the paid order before fulfillment completes.
Refresh and revisit the order without initiating another purchase.
Confirm the pending wording does not promise immediate availability.
Complete synthetic fulfillment through the approved test control.
Reopen the order and capture redacted before-and-after evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: Pending status is clear, no duplicate purchase occurs, and eventual secure access becomes available.
scenarios.validatedRule: Delayed fulfillment is durable, idempotent, and never falsely represented as ready.
scenarios.reason: A customer-facing pending state is rendered, but no approved browser control advances the synthetic fulfillment.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after customer status rendering and synthetic fulfillment control exist.

scenarios.title: Supplier failure and ambiguous procurement
scenarios.objective: Confirm supplier uncertainty produces safe customer and operator behavior without duplicate purchase.
humanSteps: Trigger the approved synthetic ambiguous outcome.
Inspect the customer-visible order state.
Confirm the customer is not instructed to buy again.
Inspect the authorized reconciliation view without exposing supplier internals to the customer.
Capture redacted customer and operator state evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: The order awaits reconciliation, no second purchase or key appears, and messaging remains safe.
scenarios.validatedRule: Ambiguous procurement must reconcile before any fallback purchase.
scenarios.reason: Reconciliation services have no customer status or authorized operator interface.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute using synthetic supplier outcomes after both surfaces exist.

scenarios.title: Payment failure
scenarios.objective: Confirm sandbox payment failure never starts procurement or reports a paid order.
humanSteps: Start checkout with the sandbox failure method.
Submit payment once.
Refresh and revisit the result.
Inspect the order/account status and retry guidance.
Capture redacted failure evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: No procurement or key exists, payment is not shown as paid, and retry guidance is understandable and idempotent.
scenarios.validatedRule: Procurement cannot start without confirmed payment.
scenarios.reason: The synthetic payment boundary is not integrated with browser checkout or customer status.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute only with sandbox payment after staging integration exists.

scenarios.title: Fraud review
scenarios.objective: Confirm a synthetic review decision blocks procurement and key release without exposing risk details.
humanSteps: Create the approved synthetic review condition.
Inspect the customer-visible status.
Confirm procurement and key access remain unavailable.
Inspect the authorized operator view for the same order.
Capture redacted customer and operator evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: The order remains safely held and customer wording omits exploitable internal risk detail.
scenarios.validatedRule: Fraud REVIEW blocks commercial progression until authorized review.
scenarios.reason: Fraud decisions have no customer status or authorized operator interface.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after least-privilege review tooling and safe customer messaging exist.

scenarios.title: Fraud denial
scenarios.objective: Confirm a synthetic denial blocks procurement and key release without exposing fraud rules.
humanSteps: Create the approved synthetic denial condition.
Inspect the customer-visible status.
Attempt ordinary customer progression and key access.
Inspect the authorized operator state.
Capture redacted evidence without risk-rule detail.
scenarios.expectedResult: Procurement and key access remain blocked with safe customer wording and no ordinary override.
scenarios.validatedRule: Fraud DENY is fail-closed and cannot be bypassed by customer action.
scenarios.reason: Fraud decisions have no customer-safe denial surface or authorized operator interface.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after least-privilege review tooling and safe customer messaging exist.

scenarios.title: Invoice access
scenarios.objective: Confirm only the owning customer can access an eligible, secret-free invoice.
prerequisites: Synthetic invoiced order owned by customer A
testData: Dedicated synthetic invoice metadata and document
humanSteps: Sign in as customer A and open the invoice action.
Inspect customer and order association and allowed invoice content.
Confirm no key, claim credential, session value, or delivery capability is present.
Sign in as customer B and attempt the same invoice path.
Capture redacted access and denial evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: Customer A receives only the eligible invoice; customer B is denied and sensitive delivery material is absent.
scenarios.validatedRule: Invoice access requires exact ownership and invoices never carry key-delivery authority.
scenarios.reason: Owner-filtered invoice availability and reference metadata are rendered, but no authorized invoice document provider or download exists.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute with synthetic invoice content after account integration exists.

scenarios.title: Refund journey
scenarios.objective: Confirm a synthetic refund remains coherent and idempotent for customer and operator.
humanSteps: Observe the customer order before refund.
Initiate the synthetic refund once through the authorized workflow.
Repeat the action and confirm no second refund occurs.
Reopen the customer order and inspect payment and key status.
Capture redacted before-and-after evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: Exactly one refund effect occurs and customer-visible order state is understandable and non-contradictory.
scenarios.validatedRule: Refund mutations are authorized, idempotent, and auditable.
scenarios.reason: No customer observation page or authorized operator refund interface is exposed.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute with synthetic provider behavior after both surfaces exist.

scenarios.title: Support journey
scenarios.objective: Confirm support interaction respects order ownership, visibility, and Product Key confidentiality.
humanSteps: Create or open support for the owned synthetic order.
Confirm the customer sees only customer-visible content.
Inspect the same case as authorized support and verify internal evidence remains internal.
Attempt cross-customer access.
Capture redacted customer, support, and denial evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: The case links to the correct order/customer, cross-customer access is denied, and no key is unnecessarily shown.
scenarios.validatedRule: Support is least-privilege, ownership-scoped, and visibility-aware.
scenarios.reason: Support services have no production customer route or operator tooling.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after customer and least-privilege support interfaces exist.

scenarios.title: Account purchase history
scenarios.objective: Confirm Meine Kaeufe shows only coherent purchases owned by the signed-in customer.
prerequisites: Customer A with direct and claimed synthetic purchases
humanSteps: Sign in as customer A and open Meine Kaeufe.
Compare order, invoice, and key-availability states with the fixture.
Confirm the claimed guest purchase appears.
Confirm customer B's purchase is absent.
Capture redacted list and detail evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: Only owned purchases appear with coherent status and availability information.
scenarios.validatedRule: Account projections are ownership-scoped and do not disclose keys in list views.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after Meine Kaeufe is implemented on approved staging.

scenarios.title: Authentication and verification experience
scenarios.objective: Confirm protected ownership actions require a verified authenticated customer.
humanSteps: Register or sign in with the unverified synthetic identity.
Attempt a protected purchase-ownership action.
Complete verification through the safe staging path without recording verification material.
Sign in again and retry the protected action.
Capture redacted state and denial evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: Unverified identity is denied, verification state is understandable, and protected actions require the correct verified session.
scenarios.validatedRule: Ownership and key paths require verified authenticated identity without custom password handling.
scenarios.reason: Controlled synthetic WordPress login maps to KeyCore identity, but registration and production verification are not integrated.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute after an approved identity provider and browser session transport are integrated.

scenarios.title: Emergency and degraded state
scenarios.objective: Confirm staging-safe pauses fail closed with understandable temporary-unavailability behavior.
testData: Dedicated synthetic checkout and fulfilled order
humanSteps: Pause one approved staging operation through authorized tooling.
Attempt the affected customer action.
Confirm safe temporary-unavailability wording and no duplicate effect.
Confirm unaffected read-only state remains coherent where allowed.
Restore the control and capture redacted evidence.
scenarios.expectedResult: The paused action fails safely without key leakage, unsafe fallback, or duplicate mutation.
scenarios.validatedRule: Unsafe mutations fail closed during outages and emergency pauses.
scenarios.reason: Controls exist at repository level without authorized operations tooling or rendered customer responses.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute only against staging controls after authority and customer transports exist.

scenarios.title: End-to-end acceptance walkthrough
scenarios.objective: Obtain explicit human acceptance of the complete critical KeyRaNo happy path.
prerequisites: UAT-001 through UAT-017 applicable blockers resolved
Synthetic catalog, customer, payment, procurement, fulfillment, and invoice data
humanSteps: Discover and select the synthetic product.
Authenticate, check out, and complete sandbox payment.
Observe the order through synthetic procurement and encrypted fulfillment.
Use secure customer access, purchase history, and invoice paths.
Review all redacted evidence and explicitly record acceptance or rejection.
scenarios.expectedResult: One coherent, secure purchase completes with exact ownership, secure reveal, history, and invoice behavior.
scenarios.validatedRule: The composed customer journey satisfies critical business and security rules without production effects.
scenarios.reason: Catalog, cart, checkout shell, synthetic login, account and reveal are composed, but payment, order creation, guest claim and full invoice delivery are not.
scenarios.humanActionRequired: Execute last, after all required staging transports and prior scenario blockers are resolved.
scenarios.approvalRequirement: Explicit ROLE-UAT-05 result and separate human approval artifact
